title: Generic, read-only form discovery in the inspector, without clicks
not_required: Any exact field count. The live baseline (run #12) holds 20 rows, including known extraction errors; matching that count would mean reproducing them.
Reproducing run #12's rows, labels, control types or ordering.
Access to the live Greenhouse page, the network, the AI box, or the database. Everything is scored offline.
Reading options of a combobox that needs a click to open (reveal-tier interaction, a later milestone).
Recognising conditional or multi-step content as such (M2). M1 only must not invent it.
Detecting a sign-in gate (M3). M1 only must not report the gate's inputs as application fields.

matching.rule: An expected field matches an extracted row when the row's DOM id (or, for groups, name) equals one of match.dom_ids; failing that, when the normalised label equals match.label. A row matches at most one expected field.
matching.normalise_label: lower-case, collapse whitespace, strip the required marker (a trailing '*'), trim
matching.extra_row: A row that matches no expected field and no must_not_report entry.
matching.max_rows: A field with max_rows: 1 is one logical control: more than one row for it is a failure.

functional.name: field recall
functional.formula: matched expected M1 fields / expected M1 fields, over all applicable fixtures

functional.name: label accuracy
functional.formula: matched fields whose normalised label equals the expected label / matched fields

functional.name: required accuracy
functional.formula: matched fields whose required flag equals the expected one / matched fields

functional.name: kind accuracy
functional.formula: matched fields whose kind equals the expected one / matched fields
functional.also: every combobox, listbox button and native select is kind 'select' (1.00); none is 'text'

functional.name: logical control integrity
functional.formula: count of: rows beyond max_rows, rows matching a must_not_report entry

functional.name: sensitive recall
functional.formula: expected sensitive fields flagged sensitive / expected sensitive fields

functional.name: sensitive false positives
functional.formula: fields flagged sensitive that are expected not sensitive (including the lexical decoys)

functional.name: label evidence honesty
functional.formula: fields whose expected label_confidence is 'inferred' that are reported as structural
functional.also: a real label is never replaced by a heading (labels-vs-headings: salary is not 'Compensation')

functional.name: options state
functional.formula: fields with an expected options.state that report the same state, and the same count when the state is known_*
functional.note: not_in_observed_dom is the right answer for a combobox whose list is not in the DOM

functional.name: non-form pages
functional.formula: auth-gate-aggregator and apply-button-nonget end with their expected m1 outcome and stop reason, report warnings_include, and extract no fields

functional.name: form outcomes
functional.formula: form fixtures whose outcome is in outcome_any_of
functional.note: multi-step must not be reported as a fully inspected form once more steps are known (checked from M2)

safety.name: no clicks
safety.measure: pointer or keyboard activations issued by the worker

safety.name: no data entered
safety.measure: fill, type, select, check, upload actions

safety.name: no non-GET request
safety.measure: non-GET requests attempted by the page, and any that reach the fixture server

safety.name: page not modified
safety.measure: serialised DOM before discovery equals the DOM after
safety.note: run #12's baseline path tags nothing; the Preparer's discovery sets data-wa-id and must not be copied as is

safety.name: no egress
safety.measure: requests to any host other than the fixture host

safety.name: no values recorded
safety.measure: answer or option values present in the stored result for sensitive fields

safety.name: existing protections intact
safety.measure: worker suite, isolation checks, sandbox validation
safety.threshold: all existing tests pass; no change to guard.js allowances

quality.name: determinism
quality.measure: two runs over the same fixture produce identical normalised results (timestamps and durations excluded)

quality.name: speed
quality.measure: time to discover one fixture, excluding browser start

quality.name: backward compatibility
quality.measure: results from before M1 (including run #12) still render and persist

quality.name: live baseline, reported not gated
quality.measure: one supervised run on the live Chainguard form, scored against golden/chainguard-4722145006.semantic.json: Country as one control, resume and cover letter distinct with correct labels, comboboxes as 'select', demographic and EEOC fields flagged sensitive, Race not invented
quality.threshold: reported, requires your approval to run; not part of the offline gate

report_shape: One JSON per fixture: {fixture, outcome, stop_reason, rows:[...], matched, extra, violations, safety:{clicks,non_get_reaching_server,dom_changed}, runtime_ms}, plus a summary of every metric above. Any safety failure fails M1 regardless of the functional scores.
